## Processing Seaflow data (only Gradients 1 through 5)

In this document, we will clean and bin the particle-level seaflow datasets
(only Gradients 1 through 5).

This is the overall setup for binning/gridding.

```{r setup}
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

## Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(readxl)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggrepel)
library(mclust)
library(knitr)

## Output directory
## (Change to your Dropbox (e.g., Dropbox/data/ocean/seaflow/.) location locally.)\
outputdir <- file.path("~", "Dropbox", "data", "ocean", "seaflow-40-bins") 

## Helpers
source(here::here("01-helpers.R"))

## Where the original, particle-level data is
## (Change to your Dropbox/data directory locally.)
raw_data_dir <- file.path("~", "Dropbox", "data", "ocean", "raw-seaflow", "particle-data-2026-09-29")
```

Here are some helper functions.

```{r helper-functions}

cat_tab <- function(title, level = 3) {
  # The leading "\n\n" forces a clean break from whatever printed previously
  cat("\n\n", strrep("#", level), " ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
}

## Saving and embedding the marginal plots
save_and_print_plot <- function(plotlist, cruisename, outputdir, height = 30) {
  combined_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plotlist, ncol = 1)
  filename <- file.path(outputdir, cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-censor-removal.png"))
  
  ggsave(filename = filename, plot = combined_plot, width = 10, height = height, limitsize = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n![](%s)\n\n", filename))
}

## Writing the reconstructed data to CSV
save_reconstructed_csv <- function(data_df, cruisename, outputdir, suffix) {
  outfile <- file.path(outputdir, cruisename, paste0(cruisename, suffix))
  write.csv(data_df, file = outfile, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("wrote to", outfile, fill = TRUE)
}
```

Here, we set some things up for gridding and binning the particle-level data.

```{r grid-info}
grid_filename = "grid.csv"
```

```{r setup-grid}
#| eval: FALSE

## Bin resolution for each dimension
fsc_small_bin_count <- 80
pe_bin_count <- 40
chl_small_bin_count <- 40

## Create grid bins.
grid_bins <- list()
grid_bins$fsc_small <- 2^seq(from = log2(0.0003), to = log2(3200),
                             length = fsc_small_bin_count+1)
grid_bins$pe <- 2^seq(from = log2(1),
                      to = log2(3200),
                      length = pe_bin_count+1)
grid_bins$chl_small <- 2^seq(from = log2(1),
                             to = log2(3200),
                             length = chl_small_bin_count+1)

## Organize them into tables
grid_bin_tables = lapply(grid_bins, function(bins_onedim){
  nbin = length(bins_onedim)
  lapply(1:(nbin-1), function(ii){
    c(coord = ii, left_fencepost = bins_onedim[ii], right_fencepost = bins_onedim[ii+2])
  }) %>% bind_rows()
})

grid_bin_long_table = grid_bin_tables %>% bind_rows(.id = "dimname")

write.csv(grid_bin_long_table, file = file.path(outputdir, grid_filename), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r load-grid}
grid_bin_long_table = read.csv(file = file.path(outputdir, grid_filename))
grid_bins <- reconstruct_grid_bins_from_table(grid_bin_long_table)

print(grid_bin_long_table)
```

## Binning all cruises

First, we will carry out the actual binning.

```{r bin}
#| eval: FALSE

for(cruisename in cruises){
  cat(cruisename, "\n")

  ## Read particle-level data.
  vct_dir <- str_glue("{raw_data_dir}/{cruisename}/{cruisename}_vct_slim")
  vct_files <- list.files(vct_dir, "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)

  cat("Length of cruise =", length(vct_files), "cytograms.", "\n")

  list_of_df <- lapply(1:length(vct_files), function(ifile){ read_parquet(vct_files[ifile]) })
  vct <- bind_rows(list_of_df)
  invisible(gc())
  
  ## Do the actual gridding now
  vct["fsc_small_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["fsc_small"]],
                                           grid_bins[["fsc_small"]],
                                           labels = FALSE,
                                           right = FALSE))
  vct["pe_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["pe"]],
                                    grid_bins[["pe"]],
                                    labels = FALSE,
                                    right = FALSE))
  vct["chl_small_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["chl_small"]],
                                           grid_bins[["chl_small"]],
                                           labels = FALSE,
                                           right = FALSE))

  ## Remove beads
  vct <- vct %>% filter(pop != "beads")
  
  ## Gridding the data and summing the Qcs in each 3d grid bin.
  gridded <- vct %>%
    group_by(date, across(ends_with("_coord")), pop) %>%
    summarise(Qc = sum(Qc), .groups="drop") %>%
    select(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord,  Qc) %>%
    arrange(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord)

  ## Aggregate to hourly level
  hourly_gridded <- gridded %>%
    group_by(date=floor_date(date, "1 hours"), across(ends_with("_coord"))) %>%
    summarise(Qc=sum(Qc), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord)
  invisible(gc())
  
  ## Each cruise's binned data is now saved to a file
  filename <- paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
  dir.create(file.path(outputdir, cruisename))
  outfile <- file.path(outputdir, cruisename, filename)

  write.csv(hourly_gridded, file = outfile, row.names = FALSE) 

  cat("wrote to", outfile, fill=TRUE)
}
```

Let's see, for every cruise, 1d plots for all 3 dimensions. This is *before* any
cleaning.

```{r create-1d-plots}
#| eval: FALSE

for(cruisename in cruises){
  ## Load data
  csv_filename <- paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
  datlist <- csv_to_datlist(outputdir = file.path(outputdir, cruisename),
                            csv_filename = csv_filename)
  ylist <- datlist$ylist
  biomass_list <- datlist$biomass_list
  dates <- datlist$datetimes
  rm(datlist)
  gc()

  ## Make a 1d plot over time for each response dimension.
  plotlist <- lapply(1:3, function(idim){
    datobj_1d <- flowmix::collapse_3d_to_1d(ylist = ylist, countslist = biomass_list, idim = idim)
    
    flowtrend::plot_1d(ylist = datobj_1d$ylist,
                       countslist = datobj_1d$countslist,  bin = TRUE,
                       x = dates) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "black", "yellow", "red")) +
      ggtitle(cruisename) +
      ylab(c("fsc (forward scatter)", "chl", "pe")[idim])
  })

  one_d_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plotlist, ncol = 1)

  # Save to Dropbox for portability
  ggsave(
    file.path(outputdir, cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.png")), 
    one_d_plot, 
    width = 16, 
    height = 12, 
    units = "in", 
    create.dir = TRUE
  ) %>% suppressMessages()

  # Also save to local figures folder so the Bookdown can be created
  ggsave(
    file.path("figures", cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.png")), 
    one_d_plot, 
    width = 16, 
    height = 12, 
    units = "in", 
    create.dir = TRUE
  ) %>% suppressMessages()
}
```

```{r display-1d-plots}
#| results: 'asis'

for (cruise in cruises) {
  # Open a new tab
  cat("### ", cruise, "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Get path to image
  img <- file.path(
    "figures", cruise,
    paste0(cruise, "-gridded-before-cleaning.png")
  )

  # Convert to a format knitr can use
  img_path <- include_graphics(img)

  # Insert HTML to print the figure (because 
  # the output of include_graphics cannot be printed directly 
  # within a for loop)
  cat(
    sprintf(
      '<img src="%s" style="width:100%%;">',
      img_path
    )
  )

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Data cleaning notes

Next, we will clean/process the binned data.

Here are some points that came up while cleaning data.

1. The binning was done using 80 bins in FSC dimension, and 40 bins in other
   dimensions. However, FSC in a given cruise usually occupies only 40-ish
   bins. 
2. Most cruises have upper CHL censoring.
3. G5 (`TN412_130`) PE values all fall in the bottom bin. Although at first
   glance these may look like censored points, they aren't! We don't and
   shouldn't remove these! (They are more like *truncated* points.)
4. G1 *might* a level jump in Prochlorococcus levels in the middle of the
   cruise. This is apparent from 1d plots and the series of 3d bin plots.

### Cleaning Gradients 3 

```{r clean-g3}
#| eval: FALSE

cruisename <- "KM1906"
csv_filename <- paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
datlist <- csv_to_datlist(outputdir = file.path(outputdir, cruisename), csv_filename = csv_filename)
ylist <- datlist$ylist
biomass_list <- datlist$biomass_list
dates <- datlist$datetimes

gg_init = my_marginal_plotter(ylist, biomass_list, dates)

## Visual tool debugging snapshot
# tt = 170
# obj = plotly_particle(cruisename, tt, 1,
#                       outputdir = "~/Dropbox/data/ocean/seaflow-40-bins",
#                       grid_filename = "grid.csv",
#                       raw_data_dir = "~/Dropbox/data/ocean/raw-seaflow/particle-data-2025-11-21")
# print(obj)

## Remove some specific dates
dates = dates[-c(21, 136:139)]
ylist = ylist[-c(21, 136:139)]
biomass_list = biomass_list[-c(21, 136:139)]
gg_after_date_removal = my_marginal_plotter(ylist = ylist, biomass_list = biomass_list, dates = dates)

## Remove top chl
res = my_edge_bin_remove(ylist = ylist, biomass_list = biomass_list, dimname = "chl_small", min_or_max = "max")
new_ylist = res$ylist; new_biomass_list = res$biomass_list
ylist_cens_after_chl = res$ylist_cens; biomass_list_cens_after_chl = res$biomass_list_cens
gg_after_chl = my_marginal_plotter(new_ylist, new_biomass_list, dates)

## Remove bottom fsc_small (slack=1 means remove bottom 2 bins)
res = my_edge_bin_remove(ylist = new_ylist, biomass_list = new_biomass_list, dimname = "fsc_small", min_or_max = "min", slack = 1)
newer_ylist = res$ylist; newer_biomass_list = res$biomass_list
ylist_cens_after_chl_and_fsc = res$ylist_cens; biomass_list_cens_after_chl_and_fsc = res$biomass_list_cens
gg_after_chl_and_fsc = my_marginal_plotter(ylist = newer_ylist, biomass_list = newer_biomass_list, dates)

combined_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plotlist = list(
    gg_init %>% add_title("Initial", .99),
    gg_after_date_removal %>% add_title("After removing some cytograms", .99),
    gg_after_chl %>% add_title("After CHL removal", .99),
    gg_after_chl_and_fsc %>% add_title("After CHL & FSC removal", .99)
  ), 
  ncol = 1
)

combined_plot_filename <- file.path(outputdir, cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-censor-removal.png"))

ggsave(
  combined_plot_filename, 
  combined_plot, 
  width = 10, 
  height = 40, 
  limitsize = FALSE
) %>% 
  suppressMessages()

ggsave(
  file.path("figures", cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-censor-removal.png")), 
  combined_plot, 
  width = 10, 
  height = 40, 
  limitsize = FALSE
) %>% 
  suppressMessages()
  
## Save removed cytograms manually for G3
removed_cytogram_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plotlist = list(
    flowtrend::plot_3d(ylist = newer_ylist, countslist = newer_biomass_list, tt = 21),
    flowtrend::plot_3d(ylist = newer_ylist, countslist = newer_biomass_list, tt = 136),
    flowtrend::plot_3d(ylist = newer_ylist, countslist = newer_biomass_list, tt = 137),
    flowtrend::plot_3d(ylist = newer_ylist, countslist = newer_biomass_list, tt = 138),
    flowtrend::plot_3d(ylist = newer_ylist, countslist = newer_biomass_list, tt = 139)
  ), 
  ncol = 1
) %>% 
  ggpubr::annotate_figure(
    top = ggpubr::text_grob(
      paste0(
        "Hourly cytograms that were removed\n", 
        paste(dates[c(21, 136:139)], collapse = " \n ")
      ), 
      face = "bold", 
      size = 10
    )
  )

rm_filename = file.path(outputdir, cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-removed-cytograms.png"))
ggsave(filename = rm_filename, plot = removed_cytogram_plot, width = 8, height = 15) %>% 
  suppressMessages()

ggsave(
  filename = file.path("figures", cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-removed-cytograms.png")), 
  plot = removed_cytogram_plot, width = 8, height = 15
) %>% 
  suppressMessages()

## Save Gridded Data (Regular & Censored)
df_reconstructed <- recombine_to_csv(newer_ylist, newer_biomass_list, dates)
save_reconstructed_csv(df_reconstructed, cruisename, outputdir, "-gridded-after-cleaning.csv")

df_censored <- recombine_censored_data(
  all_ylists = list(ylist_cens_after_chl, ylist_cens_after_chl_and_fsc),
  all_biomass_lists = list(biomass_list_cens_after_chl, biomass_list_cens_after_chl_and_fsc),
  dates = dates
)

save_reconstructed_csv(df_censored, cruisename, outputdir, "-gridded-after-cleaning-censored.csv")
```

```{r bin-rest}
#| eval: FALSE

raw_data_dir <- "~/Dropbox/data/ocean/raw-seaflow/particle-data-2026-09-22"

for(cruisename in cruisenames_other){
  ## Read particle-level data.
  vct_dir <- str_glue("{raw_data_dir}/{cruisename}/{cruisename}_vct_slim")
  vct_files <- list.files(vct_dir, "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)
  list_of_df = lapply(1:length(vct_files), function(ifile){ read_parquet(vct_files[ifile]) })
  vct <- bind_rows(list_of_df)
  invisible(gc())
  
  ## Do the actual gridding now
  vct["fsc_small_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["fsc_small"]],
                                           grid_bins[["fsc_small"]],
                                           labels = FALSE,
                                           right = FALSE))
  vct["pe_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["pe"]],
                                    grid_bins[["pe"]],
                                    labels = FALSE,
                                    right = FALSE))
  vct["chl_small_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["chl_small"]],
                                           grid_bins[["chl_small"]],
                                           labels = FALSE,
                                           right = FALSE))

  ## Remove beads
  vct = vct %>% filter(pop != "beads")
  
  ## Gridding the data and summing the Qcs in each 3d grid bin.
  gridded <- vct %>%
    group_by(date, across(ends_with("_coord")), pop) %>%
    summarise(Qc = sum(Qc), .groups="drop") %>%
    select(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord,  Qc) %>%
    arrange(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord)

  ## Aggregate to hourly level
  hourly_gridded <- gridded %>%
    group_by(date=floor_date(date, "1 hours"), across(ends_with("_coord"))) %>%
    summarise(Qc=sum(Qc), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord)
  invisible(gc())
  
  ## Each cruise's binned data is now saved to a file
  filename = paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
  outfile = file.path(outputdir, cruisename, filename)
  write.csv(hourly_gridded, file = outfile, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("wrote to", outfile, fill=TRUE)
}

invisible(gc())
```

## Processing the remaining cruises

The remaining cruises will be processed more automatically, and with simpler
rules.

1. This is the main cleaning we'll do authomatically -- every top and bottom bin
  in every dimension will be set aside and called censored data (biomass).

2. `Thompson_3` data looks pretty weird. Many cytograms to remove.

3. Next up: many of the cruises have a few cytograms that are weird (and don't
   look like a typical cytogram) and should be removed.

```{r clean-remaining-cruises}
#| code-fold: true
#| eval: FALSE

for(cruisename in cruisenames_other){

  ## Print the markdown header for the tab
  cat_tab(cruisename)

  ## Load binned data
  csv_filename = paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
  datlist <- csv_to_datlist(outputdir = file.path(outputdir, cruisename),
                            csv_filename = csv_filename)
  ylist <- datlist$ylist; biomass_list <- datlist$biomass_list; dates <- datlist$datetimes

  slack_top_fsc = ifelse(cruisename == "Thompson_3", 1, 0)
  normalize_by_total_biomass = TRUE

  ######################################
  ## Process top and bottom edges     ##
  ######################################
  gg_init = my_marginal_plotter(ylist, biomass_list, dates)
  
  res1 = my_edge_bin_remove(ylist = ylist, biomass_list = biomass_list, dimname = "chl_small", min_or_max = "max")
  g1 = my_marginal_plotter(res1$ylist, res1$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res2 = my_edge_bin_remove(res1, dimname = "chl_small", min_or_max = "min")
  g2 = my_marginal_plotter(res2$ylist, res2$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res3 = my_edge_bin_remove(res2, dimname = "fsc_small", min_or_max = "max", slack = slack_top_fsc)
  g3 = my_marginal_plotter(res3$ylist, res3$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res4 = my_edge_bin_remove(res3, dimname = "fsc_small", min_or_max = "min")
  g4 = my_marginal_plotter(res4$ylist, res4$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res5 = my_edge_bin_remove(res4, dimname = "pe", min_or_max = "max")
  g5 = my_marginal_plotter(res5$ylist, res5$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res6 = my_edge_bin_remove(res5, dimname = "pe", min_or_max = "min")
  g6 = my_marginal_plotter(res6$ylist, res6$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  ## Save and print unified plot  
  combined_plot <- plot_grid(
    plotlist = list(
      gg_init %>% add_title("Initial", .99),
      g1 %>% add_title("After CHL top removal", .99),
      g2 %>% add_title("After CHL bottom removal", .99),
      g3 %>% add_title("After FSC top removal", .99),
      g4 %>% add_title("After FSC bottom removal", .99),
      g5 %>% add_title("After PE top removal", .99),
      g6 %>% add_title("After PE bottom removal", .99)
    ),
    ncol = 1
  )

  combined_plot_filename <- file.path(outputdir, cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-censor-removal.png"))

  ggsave(
    combined_plot_filename, 
    combined_plot, 
    width = 10, 
    height = 70, 
    limitsize = FALSE
  ) %>% 
    suppressMessages()
  
  ggsave(
    ile.path("figures", cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-censor-removal.png")), 
    combined_plot, 
    width = 10, 
    height = 70, 
    limitsize = FALSE
  ) %>% 
    suppressMessages()
    
  ###########################################################
  ## Save Gridded Data (Regular & Censored)               ###
  ###########################################################
  df_reconstructed <- recombine_to_csv(res6$ylist, res6$biomass_list, dates)
  save_reconstructed_csv(df_reconstructed, cruisename, outputdir, "-gridded-after-cleaning.csv")

  df_censored <- recombine_censored_data(
      all_ylists = list(res1$ylist_cens, res2$ylist_cens, res3$ylist_cens, 
                        res4$ylist_cens, res5$ylist_cens, res6$ylist_cens),
      all_biomass_lists = list(res1$biomass_list_cens, res2$biomass_list_cens, res3$biomass_list_cens,
                               res4$biomass_list_cens, res5$biomass_list_cens, res6$biomass_list_cens),
      dates = dates
  )
  save_reconstructed_csv(df_censored, cruisename, outputdir, "-gridded-after-cleaning-censored.csv")

  ## Memory Cleanup
  rm(datlist, ylist, biomass_list, dates,
     res1, res2, res3, res4, res5, res6,
     g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, gg_init, 
     df_reconstructed, df_censored)
  
  invisible(gc())
}

cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
```

```{r 3d-plots}
      tt = tt,
      dates = dates,

  }
}
```

```{r weird-cytograms-plot}
#| results: asis

for(cruisename in names(weird_cytograms)) {

  # Open a new tab
  cat("### ", cruisename, "\n\n", sep = "")

  three_d_plots_dir <- file.path("figures", cruisename, "3d-plots")
  
  TT = length(list.files(three_d_plots_dir))

  times_to_plot <- lapply(weird_cytograms[[cruisename]], function(cur_tt) {
    if(cur_tt == 1) {
      res <- c(cur_tt, cur_tt + 1)  
    } else if(cur_tt == TT) {
      res <- c(cur_tt - 1, cur_tt)
    } else {
      res <- c(cur_tt - 1, cur_tt, cur_tt + 1)
    }

    return(res)
  })

  times_to_plot <- sort(unique(unlist(times_to_plot)))

  for(tt in times_to_plot) {
    # Get path to image
    img <- file.path(three_d_plots_dir, paste0(cruisename, "-", tt, ".png"))

    # Convert to a format knitr can use
    img_path <- include_graphics(img)

    # Insert HTML to print the figure (because 
    # the output of include_graphics cannot be printed directly 
    # within a for loop)
    cat(
      sprintf(
        '<img src="%s" style="width:100%%;">',
        img_path
      )
    )
  }

  # Close the tab
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::
